scope: Exactly the 16 saved complete states in [42.0,42.795] plus the true failed-soft endpoint; no extrapolation, resumption, planning or production change.

body_topology.body_face_selection: explicit physical body-face labels mapped to imported rest mesh

rows.native_stop_reason: Right fingers lost two-sided soft-contact opening reaction before release

region_definition: Nearest overlapping original implicit ellipsoid by (normalized radius distance-1)*minimum radius, applied to unchanged rest material coordinates; anatomical labels are approximate, counts are nodes not material volume.
limitations: Original valid mean-fan cap is the existing validator model; its valid flag does not prove embedded physical body/cap or cap independence. Invalid cap returns unknown here, never observed zero.
All COM points here are also tested against the 2mm-below-every-rim condition. Above that region mean/high cap winding and partial node counts are diagnostic, not an invariant physical inside claim.
Low-region unit/zero degree needs body embedding for a physical inside/outside interpretation; self-intersection is not certified by consistent orientation/3D rim separation.
Node fraction is not tetrahedron containment or volume fraction. No all-node/COM final retention success is inferred from partial containment or unloading forces.
An intentional smooth earlier stop/release changes dynamics; the current moving-through samples cannot predict its settled COM or provide a safe release threshold by themselves.
